title: When does the remote latent have to carry state? (task-ID vs state crossover; blind fast policy)
hypotheses: H1 crossover; H2 blind needs z-state; H3 staleness scales; H0 null
headline_result: A-test fails (LIBERO needs no state); H4 not supported as pre-registered (10k ratio 0.48 vs 0.50 bar; +36.9 pp vs task-id)

title: Plan horizon vs update period (does the k>=10 collapse come from the plan running out?)
headline_result: H1 supported: 100k k=10 H40 60.5% vs H8 38.7% (+21.8 pp; 0.88 of own teacher); H40 teacher weaker (68.9 vs 86.6%); k=20 still collapses; 10k worse with 280-d z

title: Tracking structure (age-aligned plan window + bounded per-step residual) at slow updates
headline_result: H1 inconclusive: 100k k=20 track 22.4% vs 11.6% (+10.7 pp, bar 15; 0.32 of teacher, bar 0.50); teacher replaying its own delayed plan 40.2% at k=20 (0.52 of k=1), student 17.9 pp below it; residual never near its bound; 10k student 5.9 -> 66.3% at k=10 (window also compresses z)

title: Hold start: does the start-up phase explain the track student's gap to replay at k=20?
headline_result: H1 supported: 100k k=20 gap 17.9 -> 4.0 pp with hold (0.22 of no-hold gap); track-hold 61.1% (0.89 of teacher), replay-hold 65.1%; most of the k=20 collapse in EXP-0002/0003 was the blind start; residuals do not grow in closed loop (0.005 raw); student still adds nothing over the plan
